# `version`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
version()
```

Returns the Spark version. The string contains 2 fields, the first being a release version and the second being a git revision.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `misc_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 0 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT version();
```

Result:

```text
3.1.0 a6d6ea3efedbad14d99c24143834cd4e2e52fb40
```
